sloka: वानाराणां तु षट्त्रिंशत् कोट्यः प्रख्यातयूथपाः ।निपीड्योपनिविष्टाश्च सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः ।। ६.४१.४१ ।।।।
transliteration: vānārāṇāṁ tu ṣaṭtriṁśat koṭyaḥ prakhyātayūthapāḥ ।nipīḍyopaniviṣṭāśca sugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ ।। 6.41.41 ।।।।

translations.english: Sugriva chief of all army and best of the monkey army who was equal to Garuda of beautiful wings, endowed with wind speed remained in the middle (of north and west) post.
